name: OptiGD
description: Production-grade performance optimization engine for Geometry Dash (Spatial Culling, Particle Governor, Adaptive Frame Pacing, Memory Arena).

issues.info: Report bugs, compatibility conflicts, or performance regressions on GitHub Issues.

tier-preset.name: Performance Profile
tier-preset.description: Select the baseline optimization tier. LowEnd maximizes FPS stability on integrated GPUs and mobile; Balanced preserves extra particles; HighEnd minimizes culling; Custom uses your manual parameters below.

target-fps.name: Target Frame Rate
target-fps.description: Target frame rate used by AdaptiveGovernor to calculate the per-frame CPU budget.

enable-spatial-culling.name: Spatial Frustum Culling
enable-spatial-culling.description: Accelerates camera frustum visibility queries using a 2D spatial hash grid and differential transition tracking.

enable-particle-throttling.name: Particle System Governor
enable-particle-throttling.description: Puts off-screen continuous emitters to sleep and scales non-critical particle emission density while preserving player trails and portals.

enable-adaptive-governor.name: Adaptive Frame-Time Governor
enable-adaptive-governor.description: Dynamically adjusts optimization tiers based on rolling frame-time percentiles (P50/P95/P99) with hysteresis.

enable-matrix-caching.name: Transform Matrix Caching
enable-matrix-caching.description: Caches static CCNode affine transformations across frames to avoid redundant trigonometry.

enable-trigger-indexing.name: Trigger Lookahead Indexing
enable-trigger-indexing.description: Indexes level triggers along the X-axis and by spawn group ID while preserving native trigger execution.

enable-diagnostics-overlay.name: Diagnostics Overlay (HUD)
enable-diagnostics-overlay.description: Displays real-time FPS, P50/P95/P99 frame times, culling stats, and memory arena usage.

export-diagnostics-on-exit.name: Export Diagnostics Report
export-diagnostics-on-exit.description: Writes a structured JSON performance report when exiting a level.

custom-particle-density.name: Custom: Particle Density Scale
custom-particle-density.description: Emission density multiplier for non-critical particles when Performance Profile is set to Custom.

custom-max-particles.name: Custom: Global Particle Cap
custom-max-particles.description: Maximum active particles before aggressive throttling activates when Performance Profile is set to Custom.

custom-cull-offscreen-particles.name: Custom: Sleep Off-Screen Emitters
custom-cull-offscreen-particles.description: Put continuous off-screen particle emitters to sleep when Performance Profile is set to Custom.

custom-camera-padding-x.name: Custom: Camera Culling Padding X
custom-camera-padding-x.description: Horizontal frustum guard-band padding (in world units) when Performance Profile is set to Custom.

custom-camera-padding-y.name: Custom: Camera Culling Padding Y
custom-camera-padding-y.description: Vertical frustum guard-band padding (in world units) when Performance Profile is set to Custom.
